picks.headline: Open Post-Training Recipe Released for GLM-4.5-Air-Base
picks.why: It provides a fully reproducible eight-stage post-training workflow for 100B+ MoE models using entirely public data and open reward modeling.
picks.title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe

picks.headline: Quantization Induces Hidden Grounding Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
picks.why: INT8 and NF4 quantization significantly worsen spatial grounding in VLMs without impacting standard benchmark accuracy scores.
picks.title: GHOST-Q: Towards Studying Grounding Hallucinations Overlooked Under Same-score TradeOffs in Quantized VLMS

picks.headline: Gradient Inversion Attack Exposes Private Trajectories in Embodied RL
picks.why: The TRACE attack demonstrates that policy gradients in distributed reinforcement learning leak precise agent observation-action histories.
picks.title: Temporal Gradient Inversion for Private Trajectory Reconstruction in Embodied Reinforcement Learning

picks.headline: LLM Multi-Agent Deliberation Collapses Under Deceptive Minorities
picks.why: Multi-agent LLM systems lack human resilience to deception, with defection rates scaling linearly even when bad actors are a small minority.
picks.title: How does Adversarial Influence Scale in Multi-Agent Systems?

picks.headline: Ternary Model Performance Gains Reattributed to Suboptimal Transformer Baselines
picks.why: A 98-run study shows that claimed ternary model advantages disappear when baseline depth and width parameters are properly tuned.
picks.title: Baseline Shape Decides the Verdict: A Controlled Re-Examination of Ternary Language Models at 60K Parameters

papers.headline: Real-Anchored Gradient Feedback Filters Synthetic Data Online
papers.why: FROST eliminates the need for separate verifier models by dynamically filtering synthetic training samples using gradient signals anchored in real data.
papers.title: Let Training Guide Selection: Online Synthetic Data Filtering via Real-Anchored Utility

papers.headline: Block-Wise Low-Rank Compression Speeds Up Many-Shot Contexts
papers.why: MILO applies dynamic entropy-based rank allocation to compress the KV cache for long-context prompts with minimal accuracy degradation.
papers.title: MILO: Efficient Many-shot In-Context Learning with Block-wise Low-rank Compression

papers.headline: VLMs Reason Multimodally by Generating Renderable Vector Primitives
papers.why: SVGLM allows vision-language models to construct and manipulate spatial images directly inside their chain-of-thought text generation.
papers.title: Multimodal Thinking with Renderable Programs
